Definition: properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses yᵉrêkâh where it means the flank, the rear. In Genesis 49:13, Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea, and it appears again in Exodus 26:22.
TheologicalSignificance: Zebulun dwells at the flank of the sea, and I believe yᵉrêkâh shows God placing His people exactly where they belong.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
